verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents on-call schedules for teams. A schedule is a collection of rotations, and each rotation defines the timing and assignment of shifts, which roughly covers rotations and multi-rotation layering. The changelog also mentions preserved schedule overrides. Missing for 10: any evidence of time-zone handling, round-robin coverage, explicit layer semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build on-call schedules with rotations, layers, time zones, and round-robin coverage that match how my teams actually work

citations.quote: Create schedules with rotation to manage your team's on-call
Schedules: These are a collection of rotations that is associated to a team.
Rotations: A rotation defines the timing and assignment of on-call shifts.
